metadata.title: Investigating response behavior through TF-IDF and Word2vec text analysis: A case study of PISA 2012 problem-solving process data

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values as it focuses on a binary correctness label derived from process data, not on achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply PISA sampling/student weights in its analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes individual response behavior sequences without employing multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as supervised and unsupervised machine learning but does not report any validation on external datasets.
